item.title: Fri Nov 13: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO, Gemini 4 Hydrogen, lawsuit to freeze frontier AI
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, AI Breakfast, Built In. Stories: Jensen Huang resigns, Colette Kress interim CEO, Harvey Jones board chair, stock reaction and Nov 17 earnings; Chinese labs' models reportedly carry Blackwell fingerprints; Gemini 4 Hydrogen, Gemini Decisions API, Google/Samsung Gemini smart glasses; nonprofits sue to freeze frontier AI; self-hosted Claude Managed Agents, Claude Meetings, Claude Connectors outage; Replit Agent commerce, Meta Muse calling, United blocks agent bookings; OpenAI Daybreak, IBM Granite LLMON, AWS emulator; SpaceX, SoftBank, CoreWeave, Fed warning; AlphaGenome 2, Inkling 2 Small, World Labs Atlas, Perplexity Decider; Built In AI reads.

item.title: Thu Nov 12: Nvidia board reportedly moves to oust Jensen Huang, AlphaGenome 2, Grok Bot 1.0
item.description: Sources: TLDR AI, The Rundown. Stories: Nvidia board reportedly preparing to remove Jensen Huang after second affair report, Economist and Congress calls to resign, $427B market value drop; DeepMind AlphaGenome 2; SpaceXSI Grok Bot 1.0 Team Bots; Gemini Decisions API, A2UI 1.0, Antigravity browser use, Google Tabletop; Anthropic IPO reportedly oversubscribed; OpenAI's first $10B quarter, MCP extensions, agent signals proposal, ChatGPT Business Hub; United blocks AI agents; Runway Praxis-1; MCP context costs, Perplexity sandbox escapes, filler-token reasoning; Airbnb, Shopify, Databricks, ElevenLabs Scribe V3; Claude Projects knowledge files; AI agents find possible Maya site.

item.title: Wed Nov 11: Anthropic's trillion-dollar IPO terms, Gemini 4 Carbon goes wide, ChatGPT opens for business
item.description: Sources: AI Breakfast, TLDR AI, The Rundown. Stories: Anthropic IPO roadshow, $70-78 shares under ANT, up to $1.4 trillion valuation, $26B strategic partner buy, debut Nov 19-20, AI R&D threshold met, Lambda deal terminable; OpenAI's reported $10.9B Q3 loss; more Fable 5.2 details; Gemini 4 Carbon generally available, Antigravity /swarm, Gemini for Healthcare; Businesses in ChatGPT and OpenAI buys Odessia; Claude Sheets, Whiteboards, Data, Meetings; AI 2027 authors move timelines up; Grok Build, Notion, Railway security exposures; Australia regulator and Paris Call; AlphaProof Code, MAI-Transcribe-2, Adobe MCP, GR00T 2, LongCat 2.5.

item.title: Tue Nov 10: Anthropic's Fable 5.2 takes the top spot, Meta's cheap Muse Ember, Google's new TPUs
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI. Stories: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, cheaper and faster, No. 1 on Artificial Analysis, 'pacing, not pausing'; Anthropic IPO prep, compute bill analysis, gas generators, AI accelerating AI R&D; Meta's Muse Ember agent model at a third of Haiku's per-task cost; Google TPU 8tx and 8i Max; Nvidia Megaspeed smuggling probe; Fireworks hack; OpenAI Control Room and ChatGPT Enterprise on AWS; Adobe-Disney deal; Instagram Effect Builder; Apple Logic Pro usage packs; Nvidia AutoCompress and GR00T 2; Seedream 5.5, Inkling 2 Small.

item.title: Mon Nov 9: Nvidia board probes Jensen Huang spy claims, OpenAI raises $11B not $30B, A.I. accelerating A.I. research
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, AI Breakfast. Stories: Jensen Huang admits affair as Nvidia board investigates reported foreign intelligence effort, congressional pressure, Korea worries and Nvidia's losing streak; OpenAI closes $11B at $1.25T after a $30B target, Anthropic IPO valuation pressure, Thinking Machines raise; Anthropic takes over 1.7 GW of gas generators from OnePWR; A.I. accelerating A.I. research, METR redactions, OpenAI R&D automation; PSI proves Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture with an Anthropic model; Claude agent memory 'dreaming'; policy and jobs; Inkling 2 Small, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, Perplexity Teammates, OpenRouter Auto Router, Muse Spaces; Microsoft's AI Frontiers reorganized.

item.title: Fri Nov 6: METR finds Anthropic's A.I. speedup, OpenAI's Critical-rated GPT-6 Cyber, data center votes hit chip stocks
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, AI Breakfast, Built In. Stories: METR's inside assessment of Anthropic's roughly 2x AI R&D speedup, redactions and internal models; Claude Personal Finance, enterprise DLP hooks, AP election data deal; OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber rated Critical, Firefox bugs and 948 Linux exploits; Images 2.6 adds GIFs; data centers lose 40 of 41 ballot measures, Nasdaq falls 5.5% and chip stocks slide; Pierre and Conductor follow-ups, Cat Wu joins OpenAI; Inkling 2 Small, Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, Cursor live apps, Perplexity Teammates, Notion shared memory; Stacks Project in Lean, AlphaEvolve, Nvidia Cosmos 3 and VFlash; quick hits.

item.title: Thu Nov 5: Grok Bot makes phone calls, midterm voters reject data centers, OpenAI buys Pierre
item.description: Sources: The Rundown. Stories: SpaceXSI's Grok Bot adds phone calls (users are caller of record); midterm voters back data center limits in 38 of 39 measures, NBC exit poll on AI, Goldman's capacity-freeze estimate; OpenAI acquires Pierre, Conductor joins Meta; Ricursive Ripple-65B, Tencent Hy4, Kimi K3.1 Pro; Pangram Image 1.0; tips on sketch-before-build prompting and comparing free AI tools; reader's AI family-letter archive.

item.title: Wed Nov 4: Siri AI opens to developers, Anthropic's $895B commitments, OpenAI hires Anthropic's hackers
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, AI Breakfast. Stories: Apple's Siri AI developer preview in iOS 27.3 betas; Anthropic's amended S-1 details (Q3 revenue, operating loss, $895B commitments, RSP warning) and Cat Wu's exit; OpenAI partners with Cathedral and reprices its bug bounty; CrowdStrike AI Kill Switch and acquisitions; Google ties Search to AI for K-12 accounts; ChatGPT usage numbers and LifeVal; caveats on MIT weight-editing result; DeepSeek on Huawei Ascend; quick hits.

item.title: Tue Nov 3: AI rewrites AI weights, Anthropic's IPO filing flags self-improvement, OpenAI's busy day
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI. Stories: MIT shows GPT-6 Astra improving models by editing weights directly; Anthropic's amended IPO prospectus, Q3 financials and RSI warning; Claude message threads beta and Claude Code game-rebuild refusals; GPT-6.2 Astra spotted in Codex; OpenAI LifeVal benchmark, Abu Dhabi deals, ChatGPT Chat and Work tabs merge; Grok Bot usage cuts; Marvell to acquire Lumentum for $115B; engineering notes from Copilot Cowork, Framer Harness 2, NVIDIA Cosmos, GitHub Enclaves; quick hits.

item.title: Mon Nov 2: OpenAI trims its funding round, data centers on the ballot, backdoored Claude Code extension
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, AI Breakfast. Stories: OpenAI reportedly cuts round to $20B as Big Tech capex strains cash flow and Anthropic credit outlook; midterm data center votes and OpenAI's 'compute campus' rebrand; Google Suncatcher runs Gemma in orbit; tampered Claude Code extension on Cursor's marketplace; agents raising their own spending caps; Anthropic misalignment and data-poisoning research; DeepSeek's open-source super-agent; Mythos 5.5 sighting, Claude Ultra plan, OpenAI usage changes, GPT-Rosalind-6; quick hits.

item.title: Fri Oct 30: Nvidia spy report, Anthropic IPO filing, Mistral Large 4 open weights
item.description: Sources: The Rundown, TLDR AI, Built In. Stories: alleged Chinese asset near Jensen Huang; Anthropic files to go public, becomes SpaceX's top customer, launches Claude self-assessment; Mistral Large 4 weights and open-weight exploit risk; Sam Altman on many AIs vs one superintelligence; agent swarm leadership; quick hits.
